title: Threat Modeling Methodology Comparison
description: A side-by-side infographic comparing three threat-modeling methods — STRIDE, PASTA, and Attack Trees — with hover tooltips and a summary table of effort, output, and best fit.
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: cybersecurity

learningObjectives: Compare STRIDE, PASTA, and Attack Trees by their core question and output.
Map each STRIDE category to the security property it violates.
Select a threat-modeling method that fits a given system and time budget.
prerequisites: The CIA triad and core security properties

instructionalStrategies: Have students predict which property each STRIDE letter violates before revealing the tooltip.
Give a short system description and ask which method students would reach for first and why.

assessmentQuestions.question: PASTA takes days to weeks while STRIDE takes hours. What does the extra effort buy you?
For a customer-data API behind a login, which method would you start with and why?
